content.hebrew: אֵל עֶלְיוֹן נִתְעַלָּה עַל כֵּס חֶבְיוֹן, וְנִשְׂגָּב בְּסוֹד קְדֹשִׁים, וְנֶעְלָם,
content.transliteration: El ‘elyon nit‘alla ‘al kes ḥevyon, venisgav besod ḳedoshim, vene‘lam,
content.english: El ‘Elyon is elevated upon His concealed throne, exalted in the council of the holy, and hidden;
content.comments: El ‘Elyon. A name for God; traditional English: “the most high God.”

content.hebrew: נִסְתָּר מֵעֵינֵי כָל־הַבְּרוּאִים. וְיִתְבָּרַךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹדוֹ לְעוֹלָם!
content.transliteration: Nistar me‘enē kol habberu’im. Veyitbarakh shem kevodo le‘olam!
content.english: He is obscured from the eyes of all creations. May His glorious name be blessed forever!

content.hebrew: הֶרְאָה לִנְבִיאוֹ הִשְׁתַּלְשְׁלוּת הַמְּצִיאוּת, בִּפְרָטָם וּבִכְלָלָם –
content.transliteration: Her’a linvi’o hishtalshelut hammetsi’ut, bifratam uvikhlalam –
content.english: He showed His prophet the chain of being, in specific and in general—

content.hebrew: קהל: וַיַּחֲלֹם וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם.    (בראשית כח:יב)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Vayaḥalom vehinnē sullam.
content.english: Cong. He dreamed, and behold, a ladder!  (Gen. 28:12)

content.hebrew: נִגְלָה עִנְיַן הַסֻּלָּם לְאִישׁ תָּמִים, שֶׁרֹמֵז לְעִלַּת הַנְּשָׁמָה,
content.transliteration: Niḡla ‘inyan hassullam le’ish tamim, sheromez le‘illat hanneshama,
content.english: The matter of the ladder was revealed to the unblemished man: it alludes to the cause of the soul,

content.hebrew: שֶׁהִיא הַנֶּֽפֶשׁ הַכְּלָלִית, הַשֹּׁכֶֽנֶת בָּרוּמָה,
content.transliteration: Shehi hannefesh hakkelalit, hash’shokhenet baruma,
content.english: Which is the Universal Soul, dwelling on high,

content.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר מִסִּבָּתָהּ יַשִּׂיג הַמַּשִּׂיג בְּכָל־חָכְמָה וּמְזִמָּה –
content.transliteration: Asher missibbatah yassiḡ hammassiḡ bekhol ḥokhma umzimma –
content.english: By whose cause people attain any wisdom or cunning—

content.hebrew: קהל: מֻצָּב אַֽרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּֽיעַ הַשָּׁמָֽיְמָה. (שם, המשך)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Muts’tsav artsa verosho maggia‘ hash’shamayma.
content.english: Cong. Standing on the earth, with its top reaching heaven.   (ibid., cont.)

content.hebrew: יְדִיעַת הַקָּצֶה הָאֶחָד לְמַֽטָּה, וְרֹאשׁוֹ הַנִּשָּׂא לְמַֽעְלָה, בַּגַּלְגַּלִּים,
content.transliteration: Yedi‘at haḳḳatsē ha’eḥad lematta, verosh hannissa lema‘la baggalgalim,
content.english: Knowing that one end is at the bottom, and the top is raised high up, in the spheres,

content.hebrew: יוֹרֶה לְסוֹד עוֹלָם הַבָּהִיר, וְלִידִיעַת הַשְׁפָּעַת הַשְּׁפָלִים.
content.transliteration: Yorē lesod ‘olam habbahir, velidi‘at hashpa‘at hash’shefalim.
content.english: Is indicative of the secret of the Luminous World, and knowledge of the emanation of the lower world.

content.hebrew: שֶׁהַכֹּל בִּרְמִיזוֹת נִרְמָזִים, וְכֻלָּם בְּמָשָׁל נִמְשָׁלִים –
content.transliteration: Shehakkol birmizot nirmazim, vekhullam bemashal nimshalim –
content.english: For to everything there are allusions made, and about all are allegories composed—

content.hebrew: קהל: וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹהִים עֹלִים.  (שם, המשך)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Vehinnē mal’akhē Elohim ‘olim.
content.english: Cong. And behold, angels of God were ascending!   (ibid., cont.)

content.hebrew: אֵֽלּוּ אַרְבָּעָה הַשְּׁלוּחִים יֹצְאִים לְהִתְיַצֵּב לְפָנָיו וּלְמוּלָיו.
content.transliteration: Ellu arba‘a hash’sheluḥim yotse’im lehityats’tsev lefanav ulmulav.
content.english: These four emissaries go forth, to stand in front of and to face Him.

content.hebrew: וְהֵם מִתְיַחֲסִים לָרִאשׁוֹן, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהֵם מְסֻבָּבָיו וַעֲלוּלָיו;
content.transliteration: Vehem mityaḥasim larishon, mippenē shehem mesubbavav va‘alulav;
content.english: They relate to the first One, for they are caused by Him, brought into effect by Him;

content.hebrew: כִּי הוּא הַהַתְחָלָה וְהַסִּבָּה הַפֹּעָֽלֶת, אֲשֶׁר מִמֶּֽנּוּ וְאֵלָיו –
content.transliteration: Ki hu hahat’ḥala vehassibba happo‘elet, asher mimmenu ve’elav –
content.english: For He is the beginning, the Efficient Cause, [for everything is] from Him and to Him—

content.hebrew: קהל: וְהִנֵּה יוי נִצָּב עָלָיו.   (בראשית כח:יג)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Vehinnē Adonai nits’tsav ‘alav.
content.english: Cong. And behold, Adonai was standing above him.  (Gen. 28:13)

content.hebrew: בְּהִשְׂתַּכְּלוּת הַהַתְמָדָה וְהַקִּיּוּם לְסִבַּת הַסִּבּוֹת וַעֲלוּלֵיהֶם,
content.transliteration: Behistaklut hahatmada vehaḳḳiyyum lesibbat hassibbot va‘alulehem,
content.english: Examining the constancy and stability of the Cause of [all] causes and their effects,

content.hebrew: יוֹדִֽיעַ לְסוֹד מְחֻיַּב הַמְּצִיאוּת, שֶׁזּוּלָתוֹ אֶפְשָׁרֵי הַמְּצִיאוּת בְּעִנְיְנֵיהֶם.
content.transliteration: Yodi’a‘ lesod meḥuyyav hammetsi’ut, shezzulato efsharē hammetsi’ut be‘inyanehem,
content.english: Informs [us] of the mystery of the Necessary Existent, aside from Whom are the contingent existents.

content.hebrew: כִּי גָבֽוֹהַּ מֵעַל גָּבֽוֹהַּ שֹׁמֵר, וּגְבֹהִים עֲלֵיהֶם.
content.transliteration: Ki ḡavo’ah me‘al gavo’ah shomer, uḡvohim ‘alehem.
content.english: For one guard is higher than another high one, and there are even higher ones above them.

content.hebrew: קהל: וַיַּעֲבֹר מַלְכָּם לִפְנֵיהֶם.   (מיכה ב:יג)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Vayya‘avor malkam lifnehem.
content.english: Cong. And their king passed in front of them.   (Mic. 2:13)

content.hebrew: רִאשׁוֹן לְכָל־רִאשׁוֹן הוֹפִֽיעַ לְאָבִֽינוּ נִסִּים בְּעֵין הַמַּחֲזֶה,
content.transliteration: Rishon lekhol rishon hofi’a‘ le’avinu nissim be‘en hammaḥazeh,
content.english: The First of all firsts displayed wonders to our father, in a vision,

content.hebrew: וְהִשִּׂיג הַשָּׂגָה שְׁלֵמָה אֲמִתִּית, וּמַחֲזֶה שַׁדַּי יֶחֱזֶה.
content.transliteration: Vehissiḡ hassaḡa shelema amittit, umaḥazzē Shaddai yeḥezeh.
content.english: And he attained perfect, true understanding, and beheld a vision of Shaddai.

content.hebrew: וּבְצִיּוּרוֹ הַנָּכוֹן, יָדַע מַעֲלַת הַמָּקוֹם, וְאָמַר בַּמַּרְאֶה הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה:
content.transliteration: Uvtsiyyuro hannakhon, yada‘ ma‘alat hammaḳom, ve’amar bammar’ē haggadol hazzeh:
content.english: In his accurate conceptualization, he knew the exaltedness of the place, and said, regarding this great apparition:

content.hebrew: קהל: אָכֵן יֵשׁ יוי בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה.  (בראשית כח:יז)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Akhen yesh Adonai bammaḳom hazzeh.
content.english: Cong. Indeed, Adonai is present in this place.   (Gen. 28:17)

content.hebrew: הוּא אֱלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים הַמְרוֹמַם עַל כָּל־תְּהִלָּה,
content.transliteration: Hu elohē ha’elohim hamromam ‘al kol tehilla,
content.english: He is the God of gods, who is lofty above all praise,

content.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר הֶרְאָֽנוּ נִפְלָאוֹת מִתּוֹרָתוֹ הַמְּעֻלָּה,
content.transliteration: Asher her’anu nifla’ot mittorato hamme‘ulla,
content.english: Who showed us wonders from His exalted Torah,

content.hebrew: וְהוֹפִֽיעַ קֶֽשֶׁר הַמְּצִיאוּת, אֲשֶׁר בַּגָּדוֹל הֵחֵל וּבַקָּטֹן כִּלָּה –
content.transliteration: Vehofi’a‘ ḳesher hammetsi’ut, asher baggadol heḥel uvaḳḳaton killa –
content.english: And displayed the knot of existence, which begins with the Greatest, and ends with the most miniscule—

content.hebrew: קהל: וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָֽׁלָה.   (תהלים קג:יט)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Umalkhuto bakkol mashala.
content.english: Cong. And His kingdom rules over all.    (Ps. 103:19)

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֹֽהוּ נֶאְדָּר בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ, וְעֹשֶׂה נוֹרָאוֹת בְּעֹז הוֹדוֹ,
content.transliteration: Mi khamohu ne’dar baḳḳodesh, ve‘osē nora’ot be‘oz hodo,
content.english: Who is like Him, noble in holiness? He does awesome deeds with His splendorous might,

content.hebrew: שֶׁהוֹדִֽיעַ אַחְדּוּתוֹ הַנִּצְחִית לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדּוֹ.
content.transliteration: Shehodi’a‘ aḥduto hannits’ḥit leYisra’el ‘avdo.
content.english: He who informed Israel, His servant, of His eternal oneness.

content.hebrew: וְהָאָֽרֶץ תָּעִיד עַל שְׁלֵמוּתוֹ, וְכִי אֵין צוּר בִּלְעָדוֹ,
content.transliteration: Veha’arets ta‘id ‘al shelemuto, vekhi en tsur bil‘ado,
content.english: The world attests to His perfection, that there is no Rock but Him,

content.hebrew: קהל: וְהָאָֽרֶץ הֵאִֽירָה מִכְּבוֹדוֹ.   (יחזקאל מג:ב)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Veha’arets he’ira mikkevodo.
content.english: Cong. And the world is aglow from His Glory.    (Ezek. 43:2)

content.hebrew: וְהִנֵּ֗ה כְּבוֹד֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּ֖א מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֑ים וְקוֹל֗וֹ כְּקוֹל֙ מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים וְהָאָ֖רֶץ הֵאִ֥ירָה מִכְּבֹדֽוֹ׃ (יחזקאל מג:ב)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Vehinnē kevod elohē yisra’el ba midderech haḳḳadim, veḳolo keḳol mayim rabbim veha’arets he’ira mikkevodo.
content.english: Hazzan: And behold, the Glory of the God of Israel was coming from the way of the east; and His sound was like the sound of many waters, and the world was aglow from His Glory.

content.hebrew: קהל: בָּר֥וּךְ כְּבֽוֹד־יו֖י מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ: (יחזקאל ג:יב)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Barukh kevod Adonai mimmeḳomo:
content.english: Cong. Blessed is Adonai’s Glory from His place. (Ezek. 3:12)
